text:
Boston College women's soccer to open 2026 season against Siena on Wednesday
Boston College women's soccer will begin its 2026 season at home against Siena on Wednesday afternoon at Newton Soccer Field, with kickoff scheduled for 4:00 p.m., according to an Aug. 11 announcement.
The Eagles enter the new campaign after finishing last season with a 5-8-5 overall record and a 1-7-2 mark in Atlantic Coast Conference play. Their only conference win came against Syracuse, secured by a penalty kick from Amalia Dray. Boston College also recorded draws in conference matches against No. 16 Wake Forest and California, while achieving a non-conference record of 4-1-3 with victories over FDU, Stonehill, UAlbany, and Massachusetts.
This year’s roster features significant continuity as the Eagles return 13 players who appeared in at least 14 games during the previous season, including six who played all 18 matches. Sophie Reale, last season's leading goalscorer, returns for her second year with the team. Starting goalkeeper Olivia Shippee is also back after posting an .846 save percentage and a goals-against average of 0.80 last year.
The program welcomes ten newcomers this season—five transfers and five freshmen—adding depth to the squad. Leadership will be provided by three captains: Olivia Shippee (in her first year as captain), Amalia Dray, and Baylor Goldthwaite; both Dray and Goldthwaite served as captains last season as well.
Siena arrives following a successful campaign in which it posted a 9-5-6 record during the previous year. The Saints return six starters along with four key reserves from their squad. Junior midfielder Catherine Rogers returns after earning First Team All-Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference honors for two consecutive seasons; she was tied for fifth in scoring within the conference last year with twenty points. Senior midfielder Abby Daly has twice earned All-MAAC Second Team honors during her career.
Looking ahead, Boston College will next face St. John's at Newton Soccer Field on Monday afternoon.
